usedFor: Never Bounce checks addresses with “Verify Email Address” to protect deliverability.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Joined or Updated in Your Org” in Slack, then “Verify Email Address” in Never Bounce
bestTemplate.why: A new person is checked as soon as they appear, before anyone writes to them.

watchOut: Any email you send to a checked address still waits in Needs you for your approval.
